note: Main sidebar chrome -- renders: user status, fixed icon buttons (Home, DMs, etc.), and footer links; the rooms-list is subtracted as it renders user-created channel names
Room header controls -- renders: fixed action buttons (Search, Info, etc.); the heading is subtracted as it renders the user-created channel name
Message container chrome -- renders: 'New message' button and 'Jump to recent' button; the messages-list is subtracted as it contains user-generated message bodies and names
Message input area -- renders: fixed formatting toolbar buttons (Bold, Italic, etc.) and input field; the input field is a control, not a display of user content
